notes.title: Your Computer Might Be At Risk macOS version!
notes.notes:
Along with the release of the mobile version of Your Computer Might Be At Risk, the Steam [b]version 2.1.0[/b] is available with [b]macOS [/b] support!

It has the same features as the Windows and Linux+SteamOS versions and can be played on both Intel Macs and Apple Silicon, so now you can enjoy the game no matter what platform you play on.

notes.title: Christmas Special is back for good!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=HZzZRs1qAw4;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate the end of the main development cycle of the game, [i]Your Computer Might Be At Risk[/i] receives the final version 2.0.0 with general bugfixes and the return of "Xmas Special". This time the DLC will be available forever for all players.

This update contains the following features:
[b][list]
[*] Free DLC with a short Christmas-themed episode that contrasts the tone of the main game and features new puzzles, music and scenarios.
[*] General bugfixes and QoL improvements for main menu.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Discover the origin. Return to "La Rata Escarlata".
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=g905P4zPO-k;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]"La Rata Escarlata"[/b] is the new free update included in [b]Your Computer Might Be At Risk[/b]. Accessible from the main menu, this final and independent chapter takes place in a new location not seen in the main game: the bar in the middle of the desert “La Rata Escarlata”.

This new chapter explores the origins of the game’s story and contains the most elaborate and complex puzzles. Here is a summary:
[list]
[*]Free DLC included in Your Computer Might Be At Risk for all players.
[*]DLC directly playable from the main menu at any time. [b]This new chapter reveals details from the origin of the game story and include some difficult puzzles, so we recommend to play after completing the full game[/b].
[*]Unique new location: the bar in the middle of the desert “La Rata Escarlata”.
[*]Complex new puzzles in a cyclic chapter.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345437/348e486132688a08da7d53b0fbdab6dc9038e06b.jpg[/img]
In addition, the update comes with version 1.5.4 of the game which includes the following improvements:
[list]
[*][b]Added a new "Touch Mode" configurable from the options menu that allows players to play the entire game by touching the screen. This mode is recommended for handheld PC's with touch screen[/b].
[*]Fixed missing char 'œ' in the French translation.
[*]General minor performance improvements.
[*]General bugfixes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42345437/c340c9b15cf218120c11bfa08772c5778595bc24.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Your Computer Might Be At Risk Christmas Special!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GOKn3_eFL9E;full][/previewyoutube]
With the Steam Winter Sale, [i]Your Computer Might Be At Risk[/i] receives the version 1.4.0 with a [b]DLC exclusive to this Christmas period (from today, December 22, 2022 until January 5, 2023)[/b].

This update contains the following features:
[b][list]
[*] Free DLC for all users of Your Computer Might Be At Risk.
[*] 40% discount.
[*] Playable only during the Christmas period, from December 22 to January 5.
[*] Christmas-themed episode that contrasts the tone of the main game.
[*] Expands the main game story from its ending, including new puzzles, music and scenarios.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Version 1.2.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused horizontal movement when walking in first-person levels to not work with keyboard.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added full SteamInput support.
[*]Minor SteamDeck bugfixes.
[*]Fixed bug that caused the game to not start by default in Steam language on some computers.
[*]Minor fixes in main menu and credits.
[*]Updated credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added color blind accessibility mode with support for protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia.
[*] Added hint system button in main menu.
[*] General bugfixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added 'E' key to rotate pieces in some puzzles in addition to the mouse wheel.
[*]Reduced volume on certain sounds that were too loud.
[*]Fixed a typo in prologue texts for spanish version.
[*]Fixed bug that prevents pause to be invoked in second chapter while solving a puzzle.
[*]Minor improvements on pause handling.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed grammatical errors in EVELiNE texts for the english version.
[*]Fixed loading errors that caused an object to be missing and certain events in later chapters not to be triggered.
[*]Now the hint system and autosave warnings are shown when selecting a new slot.
[/list]
